// diagnostic

E0638

This needs `{required}`, whose functions inside {required_form}, but the value's {offered_form}

What

This needs `{required}`, whose functions inside {required_form}, but the value's {offered_form}

Why

A single function value converts between its failing and non-failing forms where it is passed or stored, but the functions a list, map, optional, tuple or function type already holds keep the form they were made with

Fix

Write the same failure contract on both: `Err!` after each inner function type's return when its functions can fail, as in `[fn(Int) -> Int Err!]`, and none when they cannot

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0638: tests/ui/nested_fn_failure_mismatch.stderr.

Error [jet.NestedFnFailureMismatch]: This needs `[fn(Int) -> Int]`, whose functions inside cannot fail, but the value's can fail
  --> tests/ui/nested_fn_failure_mismatch.jet:10:17
    |
 10 |     print(first(table))
    |                 ^^^^^
